localizedValues.name: C1
localizedValues.description: Pet Friendly. Per night pet fee applies, declare pets and pay fee when you make reservation or check in at the park. Read and understand pet rules. Each cabin is furnished with a queen-size futon, a bunk bed that sleeps three, small end table, small microwave, mini-refrigerator, heater, and air conditioner.  Outside is a picnic table and fire pit with grate. Restrooms and showers are nearby.
